Yheee~★

[b]「I will Purify you!」[/b] is a [b]pixel art action roguelike[/b] game where you become a hunter and hunt monsters.

We'll come back with more good titles and news.

· Account Lv that grows through battles and account skills that make characters stronger.

· Various playable characters with their own special status and skills.

· A shop where you can unlock new equipment and obtain the equipment you want before battle.

· Drop items that help in battles, such as health recovery, range attacks, and invincibility.

· More fun and detailed combat balance.
